# V4 PHASE LOG entry-kind vocabulary (B3 §6; P34.9) — the declared set an
# entry's <kind> slot must parse to. Entry shape (BM-LEDGER-06):
#   - <date -u +%F> — <id-or-pseudo> <kind> — <payload>
# `<kind>` is the text between the entry id and the closing ` — ` of the head.
# A trailing ` #<n>` ordinal or ` + <note>` annotation is allowed
# (e.g. `interruption + resume`, `interruption #2 + resume`); the bare kind
# must be in this list. `done`/`ticket` are the landing kinds — they require a
# BUILD_INDEX row and an evidence file. B3's base set is `done`, `blocked`,
# `inserted`, `split`, `gate`, `pause`, `round`, `correction`, `restored`; the
# Round-11 working kinds in use follow it.
done
blocked
inserted
split
gate
pause
round
correction
restored
ticket
post-closeout record
post-closeout repair
orchestrator repair
interruption
harness-switch
